# docs.paypal.ai documentation

> Current PayPal APIs use REST, authenticate with OAuth 2.0 access tokens, and return HTTP response codes and JSON responses.

Generated from a mirror of docs.paypal.ai by docset_refine on the hub; 88 pages. Companion files: llms-full.txt (all pages), llms-small.txt (reference pages within ~50k tokens), llms-facts.txt (extracted units).

## Sections

- [Developer](developer/llms.txt): 31 pages, ~1,701 tokens — Get started with PayPal REST APIs, Handling API responses when integrating with PayPal APIs, Making PayPal REST API requests and 28 more
- [Growth](growth/llms.txt): 57 pages, ~3,761 tokens — Agentic commerce services, Advanced use cases, Integration use cases and 54 more
